paper: KISS-ICP: In Defense of Point-to-Point ICP (RA-L 2023)
recorded_with: reproduce.py: official kiss-icp 1.3.0, KITTI dataloader, 141-frame KITTI 00 sub-sequence rebuilt from the benchmark Zenodo release
note: This is NOT the paper's number and the checks do not compare against it. KISS-ICP's metric is the KITTI devkit one with 100-800 m segments; this trajectory is 108.3 m, so it yields exactly 2 samples against the paper's hundreds over full sequences. The value is tracked so drift in the code path is caught, not as a reproduction claim. Reproducing 0.50 % needs KITTI odometry registration.
